meta.title: Alihan Asliyuce — IT Manager
meta.description: IT manager running large-scale operations. Sees systems as a whole and turns operational problems into lasting technology solutions.
meta.keywords: Alihan Asliyuce, IT Manager, IT Operations, Technology Transformation, Network Infrastructure, Automation

hero.tagline: I use technology to solve problems, improve operations, and build systems that last.
hero.support: I run critical IT operations, look at systems as a whole, and turn operational problems into lasting technology solutions.

position.copy: Large-scale IT operations. Systems seen as a whole. Problems turned into technology, automation, and lasting digital solutions.

system.title: Technology at Scale
system.copy: Infrastructure run in live, large-scale operations.

approach.title: Transformation Approach
approach.observeCopy: I watch the system, the people using it, and the operation around it — together.
approach.identifyCopy: I look past the symptom and find the root cause.
approach.designCopy: I design a solution that fits the need and can be sustained.
approach.automateCopy: I take repeating, manual work out of the way wherever it makes sense.
approach.improveCopy: I do not leave a system where it landed. I keep shaping it against the result.

work.title: Selected Work
work.copy: Work that started as an operational need.

think.title: How I Think
think.copy: I do not only run systems. I think about how they should work better.
think.seeCopy: I treat a problem as part of the whole operation — not as a single device or app.
think.rootCopy: I build systems that remove repeating problems, not patches that buy time.
think.beyondCopy: I place technology where it improves the business, not only the IT stack.

lab.title: Digital Lab
lab.copy: Where I research new technology, build prototypes, and turn ideas into working solutions.

about.title: Technology, operations, and the space between.
about.lead: I run IT in live operations. The work taught me to see the whole picture — people, systems, and the business they serve — then turn friction into lasting solutions.
about.careerCopy: Large-scale IT operations. Each role widened the frame: from keeping systems up to leading the function.
about.leadershipCopy: Operations, projects, vendors, and people — held in one view when something breaks or something needs to change.
about.impactOpsCopy: I find repeating work and operational bottlenecks, then make the process faster and easier to sustain.
about.impactCostCopy: I judge technology spend by long-term efficiency and business value — not by the ticket in front of us.
about.impactAutoCopy: I turn manual, repeating work into software and workflows that keep moving without extra hands.
about.impactProcessCopy: I keep reviewing IT operations, cut steps that do not earn their place, and help systems and teams run cleaner.
about.lensCopy: I weigh technology decisions with the people who use them and the business that pays for them — not only with the systems themselves.
about.techCopy: Infrastructure, systems, security, and digital solutions.
about.philosophyCopy: What sets the work apart is not a single tool. It is seeing the operation as one system — then building the technology that belongs there.

toolbox.title: Toolbox
toolbox.copy: What I use to build things and keep them running.
